s.note: Green chile cheese dip, warm corn chips. Julius sizes himself up against Rambo.
s.how: Soften the onion and garlic in the butter. Toss the cheeses with the cornflour. Add the evaporated milk and cumin to the pan, bring to a simmer, then stir in the cheese a handful at a time until smooth. Stir through the green chiles, season and serve hot with the chips, warmed in the oven.

s.note: Crisp skins, cheddar, sour cream, jalapeño. One embryo split in two.
s.how: Bake the potatoes at 200C until soft, then cool a little. Halve them and scoop out most of the flesh, leaving a thin wall. Keep the flesh for another day. Brush inside and out with oil, season with salt and paprika and bake until crisp. Fill with cheddar and bake until bubbling, then top with sour cream, spring onion and jalapeños.

m.note: Roasted green chile, cheddar, griddled onions. Julius tells Traven he'll be back.
m.how: Cook the onion slowly in the butter until soft and golden, then push to the side of the griddle. Shape the mince into 4 thin patties and season hard. Griddle on high for 3 minutes, flip, pile on the green chile and cheese and cook until melted. Toast the buns, spread with mayo and build with lettuce, tomato, patty and onions.

m.note: Turkey on toast, mash, gravy, cranberry. Vincent asks about Thanksgiving dinner.
m.how: Boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with 50g butter and the hot milk. Cook the rest of the butter with the flour, whisk in the stock and thyme and simmer to a gravy. Warm the turkey slices gently in the gravy. Cook the peas and toast the bread. Lay turkey on the toast, smother with gravy and serve with mash, peas and cranberry.

w.note: Puffed fried pastry, honey butter, cinnamon. We had six fathers, says Julius.
w.how: Rub 1 tbsp butter into the flour, baking powder and salt, then mix in the water to a soft dough and rest 10 minutes. Roll out 5mm thick and cut into 12 squares. Fry a few at a time at 190C, spooning oil over until they puff, then flip and drain. Whip the softened butter with the honey, toss the sopaipillas in cinnamon sugar and serve with the honey butter.

d.note: Thick vanilla malt shake, whipped cream. Vincent finds where they made the milkshake.
d.how: Blend the ice cream, milk, malt powder and vanilla until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 frosted glasses. Top with whipped cream and a cherry and serve with long spoons and straws.
